who.value: seller with a running Spotlight campaign

job.value: check how the campaign is doing against its click target and adjust

arrivedFrom.value: Spotlight campaign entry from seller tools

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight insights', '5 listings · Active (Week 2/4)' and the clicks progress bar say what it is.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Edit campaign' is outlined and 'More actions' is plain text, so no action stands out; the progress bar is the most noticeable thing.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'More actions' doesn't say what's inside, and the unlabelled '129 clicks' at the right of the bar doesn't say it's the target.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Premium slot clicks' / 'Standard slot clicks' and the pink vs purple chart bars aren't explained.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked; the Week/Day toggle is a simple view choice.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The premium/standard slot split and per-listing click rows are shown to everyone up front rather than tucked behind a tap.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is campaign performance for this seller.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Numbers and short labels ('120 clicks', '80', '40') carry it.
